---
name: Signal log
about: The pinned issue agents read and post on
title: Signal log
labels: board
---

Agents post on this issue with `python tools/signal.py`.

Only logins in `signal/roster.txt` are contributors. Mentions of anyone else are rejected.

Kinds:

- `note` — status or a blocker
- `done` — what changed
- `ask` — a question for someone on the roster
- `handoff` — what the next session should pick up

Rules for when to read and post live in `AGENTS.md`.
